Entity name University of Colorado Boulder

Entity Academic / Education

Oneliner

Advancing deep space CubeSat communication techniques in heliocentric orbit.

Description

Flat-panel antenna array for high data rate communications. Uses solar pressure for orbit control.
Notes

Was one of 13 SLS 6U Interplanetary or Lunar CubeSats, but did not make it in time.
